summary: A new PublishHelpPage and /publish-help route were added and wired into the TanStack Router. Landing-page and dashboard/user-menu entry points appear to be in progress, but some acceptance-criteria details are not verifiable due to truncation. There are also unrequested modifications to files explicitly listed as immutable in the BuildRequest constraints.

missing_requirements.requirement: Help view includes step-by-step instructions to find the Go Live/Publish button, at least 3 troubleshooting tips, an explanation that drafts expire and only publishing via chat makes it permanent, and a fallback section explaining rebuilding a new draft and what to expect.
missing_requirements.reason: PublishHelpPage content is truncated; while it clearly contains a 'Draft vs. Live' notice and begins step-by-step instructions, the diff summary does not show at least 3 troubleshooting tips nor the explicit fallback 'rebuild a new draft' section in a way that can be confirmed from provided evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: Dashboard view includes a visible, accessible entry point from the authenticated dashboard header area to the same help content.
missing_requirements.reason: UserProfile.tsx shows a navigation handler to /publish-help, but the diff summary is truncated before showing a visible menu item/button that calls it, so the actual dashboard header entry point cannot be confirmed.

hallucinated_features.description: Modified frontend immutablePaths hooks (useActor.ts and useInternetIdentity.ts).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraint explicitly forbids editing these files; changes here are unrequested and violate the stated constraint.

hallucinated_features.description: Added actor query invalidation/refetch behavior when the actor changes.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; appears unrelated to the 'Make it Live' help flow feature.
